source.post_text:
Director Jane Schoenbrun on working with Gillian Anderson in ‘TEENAGE SEX AND DEATH AT CAMP MIASMA’.

“I think she’s been very hesitant to return to genre after The X-Files, and I’m really happy that in this movie... she is bringing such deeply serious gravitas to the role.”

replies.text: That actually makes me more interested. If Gillian Anderson was hesitant to come back to genre stuff after The X-Files and THIS is what got her, there’s probably something pretty damn good in that script.
replies.author: @MintedTools

replies.text: hesitant? more like she was waiting for the right script. finally getting her moment.
replies.author: @AiwithAnnie

replies.text: Anderson returning to genre with a serious, grounded performance sounds like a perfect creative choice.  After The X-Files, expectations will be high but this role could show just how much range she still has.
replies.author: @AliJerub

replies.text: Excited to see Gillian back in a genre role! Her talent always brings depth to characters.
replies.author: @wickspendd

replies.text: Her stepping back into genre with that kind of weight after years away really highlights how strong the material must be, balancing legacy expectations with something fresh.
replies.author: decoy

decoy_rationale: The reply feels slightly too polished and oddly balanced in its explanatory hedging between past legacy and new material.
